sources.title: Code of the Federated States of Micronesia (2014 Edition, Annotated), Title 6, Chapter 16, Domestic Relations, § 1616 (FSM Supreme Court law site; Code authorized by P.L. 18-96)
sources.said: § 1616. Age of majority. All persons, whether male or female, residing in the Trust Territory, who shall have attained the age of eighteen years shall be regarded as of legal age and their period of minority to have ceased. Source: TT Code 1970, 39 TTC § 6; TT Code 1980, 39 TTC 6.
